device.model: JN-80 Classic Analog 8-Voice Programmable Polyphonic Synth
device.category: 8-voice analogue polyphonic synthesizer, 49 keys, with BBD chorus, arpeggiator and patch memory
device.based_on: Roland Juno-60 (1982), extended to eight voices; announced February 2026 (begun as the 'Phat-12' project in 2010).

sources.title: Behringer JN-80 Quick Start Guide
sources.note: Multilingual; English pages: hook-up, controls (61 callouts), shift-function menus, MIDI CC and NRPN charts, specifications.

sources.title: Sonicstate, 'Behringer Releases The JN-80' (5 February 2026)
sources.note: 3109 VCFs, BBD chorus, poly/unison/dual modes, 200 presets (100 by Ultimate Patches in banks A-E), up to 400 user presets.

sources.title: MusicRadar, 'Behringer's supercharged Roland Juno-60 clone is now available for pre-order'
sources.note: Eight voices, 49 velocity keys with channel aftertouch, five voice modes (poly, mono, unison, quad, duo), tempo-synced LFO, polyphonic portamento; $569 / £479.

sources.title: B&H and Alto Music product listings
sources.note: 3109 VCF and 662 VCA designs; one listing gives 256 user program memories.

architecture.polyphony_mode: poly, duo, unison, quad or mono voice assignment; panel selector cycles poly, duo, unison
architecture.patch_memory_note: 400 user slots (banks A-T, 20 per bank by inference) and 200 factory presets, 100 by Ultimate Patches in banks A-E; four assignable preset recall buttons; compare and match.
architecture.summary: Juno-60 layout: per voice one DCO with sawtooth and pulse (PWM from the LFO, the envelope or manual), a square sub an octave down and noise; a 24 dB/oct resonant 3109-type low-pass VCF with envelope (invertible), LFO and keyboard modulation; a 662-type VCA under the envelope or gated. One ADSR, one LFO (with delay and manual trigger) and a high-pass filter. Two-level BBD chorus. Arpeggiator, hold, transpose, portamento, bender to DCO and VCF; velocity, aftertouch, mod wheel and pedal modulation.

modules.name: Keyboard and voice assigner
modules.description: 49 keys with velocity and aftertouch; voice modes, note priority, transpose, octave, hold, portamento (polyphonic), unison detune, voice spread, voice kill.

modules.name: Arpeggiator
modules.description: Seven modes, eight divisions, 1-3 octaves, note length, swing; 10-265 BPM, MIDI, USB or SYNC input.

modules.name: LFO
modules.description: Global LFO: 0.3-22 Hz, delay 0-6 s (auto) or fade-in (manual trigger); shapes triangle, pulse, ramp, saw, sine; sync to the arpeggiator clock.

modules.name: DCO
modules.description: Digitally controlled oscillator: sawtooth and pulse (each on/off), PWM from LFO, envelope or manual.

modules.name: Sub oscillator
modules.description: Square one octave below the DCO, on/off with level.

properties.note: Described as a global noise source in the announcement.

modules.name: Source mix
modules.description: Saw and pulse (switched), sub and noise (levels).

modules.name: VCF
modules.description: 4-pole 24 dB/oct resonant low-pass (3109 design), about 10 Hz-16 kHz, self-oscillating; envelope (normal or inverted), LFO and keyboard modulation (centred on C4).

modules.name: Envelope
modules.description: One ADSR per voice for VCF, VCA and PWM: attack to ~3 s, decay and release to 12 s; exponential or linear decay/release.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: 662-design VCA under the envelope or gate; LEVEL sets the voice level.

modules.name: HPF
modules.description: High-pass filter (band-pass with the VCF); placed after the voice sum as on the Juno-60.

modules.name: Chorus
modules.description: Analogue BBD chorus, off, I or II (a third setting appears in the CC chart).

modules.name: Bender and pedal
modules.description: Bender to DCO and/or VCF by its level controls; pedal CV and expression as modulation sources.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Stereo main outputs (chorus), headphones; VOLUME not stored.

parameters.label: POLY / DUO / UNISON
parameters.function: Voice mode selector (quad and mono via the VOICE menu).
parameters.note: CC 47: 0 poly, 32 duo, 64 uni, 96 quad, 127 mono.

parameters.label: TRANSPOSITION
parameters.function: Press then a key to transpose (C or a second press resets).

parameters.label: HOLD
parameters.function: Holds notes at sustain, or the arpeggio, after release.

parameters.label: ARP SET
parameters.function: Steps through arpeggiator settings (chosen with SELECT).

parameters.label: DELAY TIME
parameters.function: Auto: delay before the LFO acts; manual: fade-in time. 0-6 s.

parameters.label: TRIG MODE
parameters.function: Auto (keys trigger) or manual (LFO TRIG button).

parameters.label: PWM
parameters.function: Pulse width (manual, about 50-95%) or PWM depth.

parameters.label: ENV INVERT
parameters.function: Normal or inverted envelope to the VCF.

parameters.label: KYBD
parameters.function: Keyboard tracking (opens above C4, closes below).

parameters.label: MANUAL
parameters.function: Sound from the panel as set.

parameters.label: WRITE
parameters.function: Store to a bank and slot.

parameters.label: ASSIGNABLE PRESET RECALL 1-4
parameters.function: Instant recall of four patches (per RECALL MODE).

parameters.label: SELECT
parameters.function: Encoder: programs, menus; press to enter.

parameters.label: LFO TRIG
parameters.function: Triggers the LFO in manual mode.

parameters.label: BENDER
parameters.function: Raises or lowers pitch and/or cutoff.

parameters.label: Voice Assign
parameters.note: The guide's menu lists Poly, Duo, Uni, Mono; the CC chart adds Quad.

parameters.label: Note Reassign
parameters.function: Same voice or next voice for a repeated note.

parameters.label: Glide Time / Speed
parameters.function: 0-5 s (fixed time) or semitones per second.

parameters.label: LFO Delay Ramp speed
parameters.function: 0%: full depth after the delay; 100%: fade in over the delay time.

parameters.label: LFO Retrigger
parameters.function: Restart the LFO on a new key or LFO TRIG.

parameters.label: Envelope Retrigger
parameters.function: Retrigger the envelope on legato notes.
parameters.note: Listed in the CC chart only.

parameters.label: After Touch to LFO > DCO
parameters.function: After Touch to LFO > DCO depth, 0-100%.

parameters.label: After Touch to LFO > VCF
parameters.function: After Touch to LFO > VCF depth, 0-100%.

parameters.label: After Touch to LFO Rate
parameters.function: After Touch to LFO Rate depth, 0-100%.

parameters.label: After Touch to LFO > PWM
parameters.function: After Touch to LFO > PWM depth, 0-100%.

ports.label: USB
ports.function: Class-compliant USB MIDI; SysEx dumps; firmware via SynthTribe.

ports.label: PEDAL CV
ports.function: Expression pedal or CV to the Mod menu destinations (tip supplies voltage).

connections.note: Mod wheel brings in LFO depth to DCO/VCF; modelled on the LFO.
Polarity per ENV INVERT; velocity to VCF scales it.

indicators.label: LCD display
indicators.function: 2 x 16 characters: patch name, arpeggiator settings, menus, compare and match.

indicators.label: button LEDs
indicators.function: Voice mode, transpose (flashes), hold, arp, sub/saw/pulse, chorus level, portamento, recall.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Per voice: DCO sawtooth and pulse (switched), sub and noise into the 24 dB VCF and the VCA. Voices summed into the high-pass filter and BBD chorus, then stereo out.

behaviours.name: One envelope
behaviours.rule: A single ADSR drives the VCF (normal or inverted), the VCA (unless gated) and, if selected, PWM; decay/release can be exponential or linear.

behaviours.name: LFO
behaviours.rule: One global LFO to pitch, PWM and cutoff. AUTO: starts after DELAY TIME on key press; MANUAL: fades in over DELAY TIME when LFO TRIG is pressed. Five shapes and tempo sync in the MOD menu; mod wheel and aftertouch can add depth.

behaviours.name: Voice modes
behaviours.rule: Poly (8), duo, unison (with detune), quad and mono; note priority, same/next voice reassignment, voice spread and voice kill in the VOICE menu. Portamento is polyphonic (off, auto/legato, on).

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator
behaviours.rule: Seven modes, eight divisions, held notes or 1-3 octaves, note length, swing; internal 10-265 BPM, MIDI, USB or SYNC (1 PPS to 48 PPQN). HOLD latches.

behaviours.name: Programs
behaviours.rule: WRITE to a bank and slot; COMPARE switches between edited and stored versions (compare and match aligns panel controls); MANUAL plays the panel. Four recall buttons by recall mode. Factory presets restorable in the INITIAL menu; presets dump as SysEx.

receives.note: full panel and menu set: see parameter access entries
14-bit (0-4095) for continuous controls; data entry CC 6/38, inc/dec 96/97

midi.channel_note: Receive 1-16 or all; transmit 1-16 or off; DIN and USB.
midi.note: CCs work when enabled in the USB/MIDI menu.

connectivity.main_out: 2 x 6.35 mm TRS balanced, max +22 dBu, 50 ohm

omitted_from_source: calibration and LCD sub-menus beyond their names
not_in_source: programs per bank (20 inferred from 400 slots in banks A-T)
the HPF's position in the signal path (after the voice sum, as on the Juno-60)
source_inconsistencies: MAIN OUT is 'unbalanced 6.35 mm TS' in the controls list but 'TRS, balanced' in the specifications.
Chorus has 'two levels' on the panel but the CC chart lists off, I, II and III.
LFO rate is 0.3-22 Hz on the panel and about 0.3-20 Hz in the NRPN chart; LFO delay is 0-6 s on the panel and 0-8 s in the NRPN chart.
The Voice Assign menu lists Poly, Duo, Uni, Mono; the CC chart (and launch coverage) add Quad.
Voice Setup steps through voices 1-7 on an 8-voice synth.
The specifications say polyphonic aftertouch; MusicRadar reports channel aftertouch.
Retailers give 400 user presets and, in one listing, 256 user program memories.
The CC chart repeats hex 23 for CC 35 and 36 (CC 36 should be 24), and lists CC 64 and 69 both as 'Sustain pedal'.

modelling_gaps.detail: Voice modules are modelled once (per_voice); LFO, HPF, chorus and arpeggiator are common, as on the Juno-60.
Velocity, aftertouch, mod wheel and pedal depths are modelled as parameters; only the main routes are drawn as connections.
The Roland Juno-60 itself is not modelled; its service notes would allow a TB-303/TD-3 style pair.
